title: The Sting
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael and the office team attempt a sting operation to learn the sales techniques of rival salesman Danny Cordray by setting up a fake company and using Meredith as an undercover executive. Despite their efforts, Danny discovers the deception, leading Michael to offer him a job at Dunder-Mifflin. Meanwhile, Dwight confronts Danny about his past with Pam and client stealing, and Andy tries to recruit Darryl for his band. The episode ends with Danny joining the office as a traveling salesman, causing mixed reactions among the staff.

main_threads.thread: Michael and the office conduct a sting operation involving a fake company and Meredith impersonating an executive to spy on Danny Cordray's sales techniques, which ultimately leads to Danny discovering the deception and Michael offering him a job.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: What I am about to show you is of the utmost secrecy.

Michael: I owe you…a most sincere and humble apology. We were trying to watch you to see your sales technique
Danny: Okay, so you…set up this fake company, then you hired this homeless woman to impersonate an executive to spy on me
Michael: I can give you more money-there's your better life. I can let you come and go as you please-there's your freedom.

main_threads.thread: Danny Cordray joins Dunder-Mifflin as a new traveling salesman, causing tension and mixed reactions among the office staff, especially Dwight who confronts Danny about his past with Pam and client stealing.
